discussion.body: Death rules. Cael and Liraen cannot die. A scene that would kill a lead knocks that lead out and spends a main-side death flag or a Sigil crack instead. Main-side deaths are optional, marked, and normally avoidable by the obvious contingency (cut the line, refuse the kill-order, stay on the pump, stay on the lamp, walk Seris out before the overdraw). If a death happens the act still completes using the contingency named on that character feat. No game-over from a main-side grave. Game-over remains: party wipe in combat with no lead standing, or quit. Deaths never fork a second ending. They only remove later personal scenes and may crack a Sigil.
